description: Register a tool with a governance policy. Defines which agents can call it, allowed targets, blocked flags, rate limits, and HITL requirements.

allowed_agents.description: List of agent IDs allowed to call this tool. Empty array means all agents allowed.

allowed_targets.description: List of allowed target environments (e.g., ['dev', 'staging']). Empty means all allowed.

blocked_flags.description: Additional flags to block beyond defaults (e.g., ['--recursive', '--all'])

requires_hitl.description: Whether this tool requires human-in-the-loop approval

tool_name.description: Unique name of the tool to register

name: tork_register_tool
